lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What's going on here?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Why is this group chat so dead?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Don't tell me you made a separate chat

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: just for those who had fun up on the surface?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: I didn't think you'd catch on that quick,

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: but I guess I underestimated you.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What?! So I was right?

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Moran actually being perceptive?

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: It seems the world has turned topsy-turvy.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What the... What do you mean by that?!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Oh, right!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet!!!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Did you really create another group chat without me?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Answer me!!
No, everyone's just pulling your leg.
Sorry. I'll invite you next time.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So it's true?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: And... you're in on it, Cadet?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You betrayed my trust!
Just kidding, hehe.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Really???

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hahaha, I knew it!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I knew you'd be loyal to me!

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Whether Mister's jesting or not,

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: the fact that we all went up to the sea with him remains unchanged.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: You do realize that, right?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: All of us, with the notable exception of one nincompoop.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Oh come on!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Seriously?!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You were so unwilling at that time,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: and now you're ganging up on me?!

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Moran,

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: how about calming down a little?

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: I can feel your frantic energy even from the messages.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Yeah, don't make a fuss.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: If you're itching that badly to join us,

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: I'll have a kiddie pool set up right in front of the Peony Association today.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: You can splash around there to your heart's content.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Oh! Does that mean you'll add me to that group chat?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: I'll think about it.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: All right, I'll be waiting!
Moran, wait.
There is no response from Moran.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: She must have really felt left out.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}-kun,

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: why don't you go keep her company?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Whoa, that's quite unlike you, madam.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: I can still vividly recall

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: your relentless attempts to keep Mister all to yourself, you know.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: She took the reins for all three organizations

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: while we were away.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: So she must have had a hell of a time.

lines.speaker: sakura_s
lines.text: Consider this me repaying her for overseeing Seimeikai.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: In that case, I don't owe her a thing anymore :3

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Anyhow, I should get someone to set up that pool.

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Mister,

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Mister, I've got a favor to ask!

lines.speaker: rosanna_s
lines.text: Go and cheer up that goofball for me.
Sure.
